theme: computer vision for trust and safety
reason: TrustHeritage verifies media authenticity with forensics and semantic similarity; VantaAI detects manipulated/deepfake images for abuse prevention — both apply computer vision to trust problems.
SAGE-PI detects indirect prompt injection in LLM inputs; LawGorithm detects scam content — both are NLP-based adversarial-content classifiers.
Both projects treat accessibility as a product constraint: NeuroBridge through neurodivergent support tooling, fAImer through multilingual and offline-first access.
NeuroBridge focuses on emotional safety and cognitive accessibility, while VantaAI focuses on digital dignity and reducing online harm.
DelAI is the clearest applied expression of Anita's DSA focus on graph theory, weighted routing, and optimization.
Both were built and won under extreme time constraints — DelAI in a 24-hour hackathon, CivicAid in a pitch-only round with no build time at all.
Both are React/Vite/Tailwind frontends built with a BetaLabs or KSUM team, but Cupid's Ledger optimizes for a one-day traffic spike while NeuroBridge optimizes for sustained accessibility.
The GitHub repository Neurobridge (and its rebuild, Neurobridge_V2) is the codebase for the NeuroBridge project.
